Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III.
Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

All bikes are cars.
Some cars are trucks.
All trucks are cycles.

I. Some cars are cycles.
II. Some cycles are trucks.
III. Some bikes are trucks.

options.label: A
options.option_text: Only conclusions II and III follow.

options.label: B
options.option_text: Only conclusions I and III follow.

options.label: C
options.option_text: Only conclusions I and II follow.
